# ElixirHealthCheck v0.1.12 - Table of Contents

Simple health check library for Elixir applications with support for Ecto, Redix and Kaffe.

## Pages

- [HealthCheck](https://elixir-health-check.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [HealthCheck](https://elixir-health-check.hexdocs.pm/HealthCheck.md): Provides functions to check the health of the application and its dependencies.

- [HealthCheck.Server](https://elixir-health-check.hexdocs.pm/HealthCheck.Server.md): Provides a convenient way to start a Bandit server for health checks.
